title: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group delays the general availability of PostgreSQL 19 after LLM-assisted code reviews uncovered architectural defects (Lindsay Clark/The Register)
summary: Lindsay Clark / The Register: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group delays the general availability of PostgreSQL 19 after LLM-assisted code reviews uncovered architectural defects — Core devs revert up to 10 features, push release to November, and blame better tooling rather than vibe coding
